5.title: Bounded deterministic execution and durable delegation
acceptance: Prescribed command batches execute without model-mediated stage transitions, stop on failed/incomplete predicates, and always retain an integrator semantic gate.
Work orders, root/permission/route binding, dependency ownership, concurrency and budget limits are validated before execution; malformed or stale orders cause no dispatch.
Dispatch, report production, collection and acceptance are durably distinct; duplicate/reordered events and crash boundaries do not silently relaunch mutations or lose ownership.
Eligible truncation supports one bounded report-only recovery or an explicit unsupported/blocked result; intentional cancellation is never automatically resumed.
Codex and Claude adapters preserve native permissions and authentication, expose capability limits, and avoid LLM polling; each claimed native combination has direct evidence.
Existing board, evidence and test-runner contracts remain authoritative; direct execution is available, and no mandatory daemon, second tracker, automatic billing switch or fleet dependency appears.

6.title: Project-aware turnkey usage capture and MASK selection
acceptance: A zero-argument invocation selects cwd rather than the shared skill/source checkout, creates a new readable metadata ZIP, and works without mandatory board configuration or pip installation.
--mask-projects uses only public MASK project.list JSON, preserves unavailable registrations, validates root_identity, keeps worktrees distinct and never widens or mutates scope on errors.
Both primaries and subagents are captured with versioned tool/control identities, preceding counter baselines, structured final results and explicit unknown/unsupported evidence.
Large histories are streamed with bounded memory/indexing and visible truncation/coverage; a sample remains usable while concurrent writers append.
Default exports exclude raw task/source/credential/command/reasoning content, linked skill files stay unchanged, existing output is preserved, and no model/network/upload occurs.
Installed canonical and MASK-linked execution is verified on native macOS and Windows, including nested cwd, a Windows launcher and two registered worktrees; no cross-host completeness is implied.

7.title: Reconciled usage accounting, account limits and task outcomes
acceptance: Claude fragments/aggregates and Codex snapshots/counter epochs/forks reconcile without double counting; unknown/missing/conflicting consumption is explicitly excluded or bounded.
Optional rate-card estimates preserve category inclusion, effective dates and service tiers and are never labelled actual subscription percentages or credit debits.
Native/manual quota helpers capture only allowed account observations with identity and freshness; they never start model work, buy credits, redeem resets or silently repair authentication.
Task/attempt joins distinguish delivered, collected, accepted and reopened work; all-in comparisons include primary, child, retry, recovery, review and repair while retaining unassigned work.
Offline v1/v2 archive reports validate privacy/integrity/bounds and expose partial coverage, opaque pools, overlapping-account activity and uncertainty instead of false exact totals.
Controlled runner, routing and instruction experiments have separate treatment IDs, fixed comparison conditions, explicit spend ceilings, independent acceptance and an honest inconclusive outcome.

8.title: Routing profiles, compact instructions and portable rollout
acceptance: Baseline and low-first profiles preserve explicit user authority, select routine/deep work deliberately and decouple worker changes from reviewer settings without inventing new personas.

Fallback/escalation receipts distinguish task difficulty, quota, unavailability and actual serving routes; capability or billing changes require scoped approval and no reset/credit action is automated.
Delegated roles default to leaves with truthful enforcement claims; legacy roles/banners remain analysable and test-runner authority stays mechanical.
Compact progressive-disclosure instructions preserve original constraints, acceptance and uncertainty while avoiding mandatory duplicated provenance or broad context injection.
Canonical and MASK-managed adoption is scoped and reversible, respects pinned artifacts and unrelated settings, and never treats --mask-projects collection as deployment authority.

A bounded, separately attributed runner/routing/instruction evaluation records quality, all-in cost and actual limitations; promotion or retention/rollback is an explicit evidence-based owner decision.
